rationale: SaaS Workforce Dashboard requiring authority, high legibility, and clear data hierarchy. Strict structural monochrome base allowing the user-mandated role colors and critical alerts to instantly draw focus.

layout.sidebar: w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen border-r border-slate-200 bg-white z-40
layout.main_content: ml-0 sm:ml-64 p-4 sm:p-8 min-h-screen bg-slate-50

bento_grid.base: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6

layout.spacing: Generous inner padding for cards (p-6) with tight grid gaps (gap-4/6)

components.cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border (border-slate-200), no drop shadow by default. Hover adds shadow-sm and -translate-y-[1px]. rounded-lg or rounded-xl max.
components.buttons: Sharp corners or subtle rounded-md. Primary CTA uses role-based color if specific to role, else Slate-900. High contrast text.
components.inputs: Shadcn defaults customized with 1px border-slate-300, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-400. bg-white.
components.critical_alert_banner: Fixed top-0 left-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-b-2 border-red-600 p-4 flex justify-between items-center shadow-lg
components.kanban_board: Horizontal scrolling container. Columns are bg-slate-100 rounded-lg p-2. Cards are bg-white, border border-slate-200, cursor-grab.
components.avatar: Square or slight rounded-md for modern SaaS feel, rather than circles.
components.badges: Inline-flex, items-center, px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-medium bg-opacity-10 border

motion.stagger_list: Framer motion staggered entry for dashboard widgets and audit log rows

icons.style: weight='regular' for UI, weight='fill' for active sidebar links

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Recharts for mood trends: yarn add recharts
Use standard Shadcn components but strip excessive rounding and shadows to match E1 rules.
Ensure 'Critical' escalation tasks pop a modal with mandatory 10+ char reason.
Data structure must heavily depend on 'company_id' scoped context.
Sidebar navigation hidden on mobile behind hamburger menu, ALWAYS visible on desktop.
Do not use transparent background on header. Overlap must be handled with margin/padding.
